parse_cases.stdout:
usage: python -m src.model_adaptation.cli [-h]
                                          {pilot,train,convert,doctor,phase40-preflight,phase40-build-source-bundle,phase40-build-input-bundle,phase40-verify-input-bundle,phase40-verify-run-request,phase40-verify-run-evidence,phase40-render-graphs,phase40-validate-notebooks,phase40-finalize-comparison,phase40-freeze-scope-amendment,phase40-verify-review-queue,phase40-finalize-human-review,phase41-prepare-evaluation,phase41-verify-preauthorization,phase41-authorize-evaluation,phase41-run-once,phase41-freeze-deployment-fit-disposition,phase41-export-evidence,phase41-verify-evidence} ...

positional arguments:
  {pilot,train,convert,doctor,phase40-preflight,phase40-build-source-bundle,phase40-build-input-bundle,phase40-verify-input-bundle,phase40-verify-run-request,phase40-verify-run-evidence,phase40-render-graphs,phase40-validate-notebooks,phase40-finalize-comparison,phase40-freeze-scope-amendment,phase40-verify-review-queue,phase40-finalize-human-review,phase41-prepare-evaluation,phase41-verify-preauthorization,phase41-authorize-evaluation,phase41-run-once,phase41-freeze-deployment-fit-disposition,phase41-export-evidence,phase41-verify-evidence}
    pilot               Run the Phase 3 pilot scaffold
    train               Run the Phase 3 training scaffold
    convert             Convert one trained adapter into a GGUF artifact
    doctor              Check local Phase 3 training readiness
    phase40-preflight   Authorize the canonical Phase 40 train and validation snapshots
    phase40-build-source-bundle
                        Build the deterministic allowlisted Phase 40 source transfer bundle
    phase40-build-input-bundle
                        Build the deterministic canonical train/validation-only transfer bundle
    phase40-verify-input-bundle
                        Verify a request-bound input archive before opening its data members
    phase40-verify-run-request
                        Verify the immutable Phase 40 source and train/validation transfer authorities
    phase40-verify-run-evidence
                        Rehash and verify one complete Phase 40 run-evidence bundle
    phase40-render-graphs
                        Rebuild Phase 40 loss graphs from retained raw events and metrics
    phase40-validate-notebooks
                        Statically validate the three canonical Phase 40 notebook controllers
    phase40-finalize-comparison
                        Reverify local QLoRA/PhoBERT plus the resource-only LoRA probe
    phase40-freeze-scope-amendment
                        Freeze the request-bound local two-full-model scope waiver
    phase40-verify-review-queue
                        Re-derive a frozen review queue from comparison/input authorities
    phase40-finalize-human-review
                        Freeze exact-coverage Vietnamese review notes without changing predictions
    phase41-prepare-evaluation
                        Freeze the code-fixed Phase 41 preauthorization without opening the holdout
    phase41-verify-preauthorization
                        Verify frozen Phase 41 preauthorization without loading models or data
    phase41-authorize-evaluation
                        Record the exact explicit one-shot authorization
    phase41-run-once    Run the sole canonical two-model reserved evaluation
    phase41-freeze-deployment-fit-disposition
                        Freeze the precommitted post-evaluation deployment-fit choice
    phase41-export-evidence
                        Mirror verified ProgramData evidence into an immutable repo export
    phase41-verify-evidence
                        Verify terminal evidence without an opener, split, predictor, or model

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
